entries.reason: The change shifts `senti presets list` from static built-in data to project-aware registry output, but the draft does not include an explicit inventory of retained public behavior being moved/replaced for this command before implementation.; There is no per-behavior migration mapping identifying where retained outputs (for example tree formatting contract, aliases, markers, or legacy-only paths) are owned after the migration, only a general fallback intent.; Behavior-level verification is specified for plugin-chain and base-only presence, but no retained-surface verification is specified for all preserved public output behavior (e.g., root/branch formatting, labels, aliases, scan markers, template-availability marker).; The statement `should improve diagnostics for existing projects...` is not stated as a verifiable condition, so implementers cannot agree objectively when it is satisfied.; `should improve diagnostics` lacks measurable acceptance criteria and is therefore not sufficiently specific for independent reviewers to determine pass/fail.

observations.observed: The change shifts `senti presets list` from static built-in data to project-aware registry output, but the draft does not include an explicit inventory of retained public behavior being moved/replaced for this command before implementation.

There is no per-behavior migration mapping identifying where retained outputs (for example tree formatting contract, aliases, markers, or legacy-only paths) are owned after the migration, only a general fallback intent.

Behavior-level verification is specified for plugin-chain and base-only presence, but no retained-surface verification is specified for all preserved public output behavior (e.g., root/branch formatting, labels, aliases, scan markers, template-availability marker).
The statement `should improve diagnostics for existing projects...` is not stated as a verifiable condition, so implementers cannot agree objectively when it is satisfied.
`should improve diagnostics` lacks measurable acceptance criteria and is therefore not sufficiently specific for independent reviewers to determine pass/fail.
